dialogues.precomment:
You are running.#

Efeliah's voice in your mind is what set you all moving, and your legs have not stopped since.#
Instinct.# The raw, animal certainty that something is very, very wrong.#

Smiurl is ahead of you, scrambling over rocks with a nimbleness no human could match.
Corolla is right behind you,# her breathing sharp and controlled.
Theo brings up the rear, his heavy footsteps like muffled thunder.#

Math is half-guiding, half-pulling Efeliah as she runs with her eyes wide open,#
staring at something none of you can see.##

Her voice slides into your mind:
dialogues.line: Somebody is following us.# Many of them.# And they are... evil.

dialogues.precomment:
You keep running, your sword banging against the narrow rock walls, sparks flying off the stone.#
The canyons twist and turn, one passage bleeding into another.#
You have no idea where you are going.# Nobody does.

dialogues.line: Close.# Very close.# We need to hide.# Now!!

nodes.recap: Theo finds hiding spots in dead end crevice
nodes.text:
Theo stops.##

One second he was running, the next he is simply still,
his arm out like a bar across your chest before you can run past him.#
No explanation, no hesitation: he points you toward a gap in the canyon wall.#
A crevice.# Just wide enough for a body.##

You go.# All of you.# Corolla pushes Smiurl in first.#
Math pulls Efeliah after him.##
You press yourself flat against cold stone as Theo squeezes in last.##

You wait.

nodes.recap: colored lights approach - the two lights, dancing, probe
nodes.text:
First, nothing.## For a long time, nothing at all.#

Then the darkness in the passage shifts.#
Faint colored reflections begin playing off the canyon walls: dancing, wavering, as if cast by something in motion far away.#
The rocks seem to tremble with them,# weaving in and out of the shadows.##

Corolla reaches for Smiurl and clamps a hand over his mouth before he can make a sound.##

For endless seconds nothing else happens.# The colored shimmer moves but nothing arrives.##
Then,# abruptly,# the dark gives way to two lights,# one bluish,# one yellow,# drifting into the passage.##
They dance around each other without any apparent logic, suspended about a meter from the ground.#

$c<<They remind me of bees...>>##

$CBut the more you watch them,# the more the terror inside you grows.##
You are frozen.##
You cannot move a single muscle.

nodes.recap: lights linger and probe - Efeliah screens the group
nodes.text:
The lights keep dancing in front of you,# as if reluctant to give up,# not quite convinced.##

You manage to shift your gaze toward Efeliah's hiding spot.#
You can barely make her out; the dark is almost total,#
and the reflections thrown by the two lights swirl too fast, too erratically.##
But you hear her voice, so low you barely catch it yourself:##

$g"Try to stay calm. Math and I are trying to screen us."$C#

You understand she means all of you.# You tell Theo, your own voice barely a breath.#
He does not move, but a tiny glance tells you he has understood.##

The lights are still there,#
and if they were to drift close to the rock face and examine it,#
they would certainly find you.##

Time moves so slowly you think you might go mad if this lasts much longer,# bursting at the seams with adrenaline.

nodes.recap: lights begin to withdraw then one returns
nodes.text:
Slowly at first, barely perceptibly, then more decisively, the lights withdraw.#
As they keep dancing that senseless dance around each other, they retreat back toward the wider space.##

Faint reflections continue to wash over the rocks.#

$g"Don't move."$C comes Efeliah's voice.# And Math's.#
It is unnecessary, really: you feel like you'll need several hours before thinking about moving again.#
Besides, a faint light is still coming from the canyon passage.##

Then, without warning, a yellow light, perhaps the same one from before,#
darts out from behind the rocks directly ahead.##

Your heart misses a beat.#
The light is racing along the canyon walls at close range.#
You press yourselves flat behind the boulder,# right when it's about to pass in front of you.##

Finally,# after hesitating over your hiding spot,# it carefully moves away,
casting slanted rays into the small grotto.#
And,# as suddenly as it appeared,# vanishes again.##

After a few minutes the light from the passage begins to fade.#
After further long,# interminable minutes,# it disappears entirely.##

You let your muscles go,# stretch out in the cramped hiding space,
your back against the boulder that has sheltered you, and breathe.

nodes.recap: aftermath - Efeliah clears them, discussion of what the lights were, Kriss recognises the canyon lights

dialogues.line: We can come out now. They're gone.
dialogues.comment:
Efeliah's voice, out loud this time.# You all descend from your hiding places.#
Corolla arrives last, Smiurl in tow. Evidently it took some convincing to get him to move at all.

dialogues.precomment: You stand in the empty passage.# Nobody speaks for a moment.
dialogues.comment: It comes out quieter than you intended.

dialogues.line: The spirits that protect the city...
dialogues.comment: His voice is barely above a whisper.

dialogues.line: They were not spirits.# Beneath their mental screens, we perceived human minds.
What? Mental screens? Human minds? What are you talking about?
dialogues.comment: Her tone is sharp, but she is asking in earnest.

dialogues.line:
Barriers that prevent thoughts from filtering out from the mind that generates them.#
We generated one too, to avoid being detected.#
You did not notice, but we used your energies as well.

But their screen was completely different.#
In material terms, how to put it...
it was perfectly smooth. Symmetric.# Almost mechanical.
dialogues.comment: Of course, nobody seems to understand the explanation.

dialogues.line: In the wider space there were many more of them, I couldn't count them.

We've seen those lights before."$C You say, quietly.#

$c"Before the Mazerock, on the road here.#
The convoy of the Horde escort.#
Those same lights had come, the same colors.#
And then the blinding flash, the silence... and when it was over, there was nobody left.

nodes.text:
$B"Better move now."$C Theo states, breaking the silence, then starts to climb up the slope.#

$Y"Could there be more of them, up there?"$C Smiurl asks, still frightened.#

$c"I want to go and see."$C#

In a few minutes you have climbed to the top of the slope and pulled yourselves up past the canyon's edge.#
You stand upright and look out.##

You stay rooted to the spot, mouth open.##

Before you the ground falls away, and at the centre of that enormous depression,
some two kilometers away, sits a dome.#
Hemispherical,# multicolored,# luminous with an incredible, almost impossible brightness.#
Through it you can make out the outlines of tall golden palaces, apparently built from light itself.#
It is an absurd spectacle: at once terrifying and extraordinary.##

You stand there, staring, mesmerized.#
A ludicrous,# ginormous,# $Rs$Co$Ga$Bp $Rb$Cu$Gb$Mb$Yl$We,$C# shining with an energy you have no words to describe.

nodes.recap: Ayonn exclaimed, Smiurl names shield, they start toward it

dialogues.precomment: $Y"Ayonn!"$C# cries Smiurl, along with the two telepaths.# Then he adds, to clear any doubt:
You all stand there for a few minutes more just looking at it.## Finally, you get to your feet.
dialogues.line: Well then! What are we waiting for? Ayonn is waiting for us!
dialogues.comment:
You start walking.# Your voice came out far more confident than you actually feel.#
Because the more you stare at that dome in the centre of the valley, the more an inexplicable fear grows inside you.#
You realize you cannot reason clearly for more than a few seconds straight.#
You cannot even analyze what is frightening you so much.##

You glance back, and see that the others are following,
and from their expressions you understand they must be feeling more or less the same.

nodes.recap: approach Ayonn or find another way
nodes.text:
By the halfway point the light is bright as day.#
You stop for a moment.# Your minds need the rest more than your legs do,
since you have been walking gently downhill.##

$g"I don't think I can take much more of this"$C says Efeliah, exhaling.#
$R"It's unbearable! What's happening?!"$C Corolla complains, pressing her hands to her temples.#
$m"The panic seems to come straight from the city"$C Math says quietly.# 
$m"But the more we focus on it, the less ground we'll cover."$C##

You try to think.# The panic grips your brain and your stomach,
and the harder you concentrate the more your head seems to heat up and fill with lead.#

$c<<Maybe we should try thinking of something beautiful. Something reassuring. Anything but this.>>$C

choices.desc: Press forward, trying to think of something calm and beautiful.
Maybe there's another way in. Circle the dome and look for a gap.

nodes.text:
You spend what feels like an hour circling the base of the dome.#
The shield extends in every direction,# a perfect hemisphere with no gaps,# no seams, no weakness you can discern.##

Every direction you try, the dread intensifies.#
Your head throbs.# Your vision blurs at the edges.#
Smiurl has stopped trying to hide his fear and is openly clinging to Theo's belt.##

Math shakes his head.##

$m"There is no gap. No back door."$C##

Corolla kicks a rock in frustration.#

$R"Then we go through the front."$C

nodes.recap: Surge attempt 1 - push toward the wall (tutorial fires here); Smiurl drops
nodes.text:
You advance.# Trying to think of something beautiful,# reassuring.# Anything.##

$g"Do that.# Try as hard as you can"$C Efeliah says, straightening up.#
$g"All of you.# Think... happy thoughts."##

$CSmiurl is hunched into himself and nods pathetically.#
He starts walking again, propelled by Corolla.##

The first few hundred metres pass quickly enough.# Then the mental pressure begins to build in earnest.#
It grows exponentially.# You find yourself, in one corner of your mind, recalling an old school lesson
about electric and gravitational fields, how force is inversely proportional to the square of the distance.#
Oddly, it helps.# It lets you detach, concentrate on your own old world,
where you led an ordinary life, day after day;
where there were no raiding hordes, no mysterious flying lights, and certainly no cities protected by magic shields.##

But the harder you concentrate, the more your head feels like it is about to explode.#
Whatever that is, it surrounds you and attacks you from within, impossible to resist.#
The mental pressure makes you feel like a walnut under a steamroller.##

You cast your eyes up: a few dozen metres remain before the wall of light.

challenge.successmessage:
You turn slowly, your face contorted in the spasm of mental strain.##

Smiurl is many dozens of metres behind you now, hopping and skipping as though deranged,
before darting away and disappearing behind a low bush.

nodes.recap: Surge attempt 2 - push again; Corolla drops
nodes.text: You take another step, still watching.#

challenge.successmessage: Just ahead of that, Corolla is stretched out on the ground.
challenge.failuremessage: Just ahead of that, Corolla is stretched out on the ground.

nodes.recap: Surge attempt 3 - push again; Theo drops
nodes.text: The pressure doubles and brings tears to your eyes.#

challenge.successmessage: Further forward still, Theo has set his hammer on the earth and is leaning his full weight on it, unable to go further.
challenge.failuremessage: Further forward still, Theo has set his hammer on the earth and is leaning his full weight on it, unable to go further.

nodes.recap: Surge attempt 4 - push again; Efeliah drops, fury ignites
nodes.text:
You stagger, and by a miracle manage to stay on your feet.##

Beyond him, Math and Efeliah still advance, slowly, painfully, holding hands.##

The last hope is going out inside you.# Everything is finished.#
It is simply not possible to resist a force like this.#
You may as well lie down and wait for the oblivion that will surely bring its relief.

challenge.successmessage:
Then you see her.##

Efeliah has dropped to her knees, still holding Math's hand... until her grip slips.#
She collapses forward, eyes rolling back.##

You see it as though in slow motion:# the whites of her eyes.# Her mouth, half-open.#
Her hair trailing behind her as she falls slowly, slowly, face-first.#
The dust she raises with the displacement of her own weight.##

And then,# in an instant,# $Rfury$W fills you.###

$RWith one corner of your awareness you see Math staring at you, stunned, already lurching toward you.#
But you have already started moving, decisive, toward the shield of light.##

You are not thinking.# Only an inextinguishable flame, suddenly rekindled at the sight of Efeliah, burning in your mind.#
You can feel the panic screaming mercilessly and angrily against you.# You can even feel the impact of it.#
It feels like your skull is close to bursting.

nodes.recap: Surge attempt 5 - the release; near-unfailable, Kriss doesn't choose this
nodes.text:
You begin to grind your teeth.#
A low, guttural growl rises from your throat.##
You reach out your hands.##

The wall of light is just one metre away.

nodes.recap: the breach - you drag Math through
nodes.text:
The pain is unbearable.# But the more it grows,# the more it feeds your fury.#
And that is what feeds that last flame keeping you upright.##

You feel Math's hand on your shoulder. He is collapsing onto you.#
You let it slide down your arm and take his own arm in your hand,# and press on toward the light.#

You cannot see anymore.# The light burns in directly into your mind.##

You scream.# And in a final surge of rage you cross the last metre, dragging Math behind you.##

For a fraction of a nanosecond the pressure in your head is insupportable, only to drop, instantly, violently.##

A blinding flash and a deafening boom fill the air,
and charges of energy crackle and discharge in all directions around you.#

The light drops sharply, falling to the natural light of the stars.# With it the panic flees.##

And a moment later you feel your own consciousness slide away, as you fall to the ground.

Darkness.##

At some point, no sense of time nor space now, there are voices.# Muffled,# arriving through layers of nothing.##

$dGrey.#
$CNot golden.#
You open your eyes for one instant and it is only grey sky, ordinary,# and someone is carrying you.##

Then nothing at all.
